# MCP tools

English | [日本語](README.ja.md)

<!-- Generated by scripts/mcp_catalogue.py. Do not edit: change scripts/mcp-catalogue/tools.tsv and run it. -->

Agent Fleet gives agents and assistants MCP tools for operating Agent Fleet itself.
Which of them a client sees depends on where it connects from.

| Column | Who uses it | How it connects |
|---|---|---|
| Session | the agent in a session | Built in, as the MCP server `af` |
| Assistant | an assistant chat in the Console | Built in, when the assistant's tools are "AF read" or "AF write" ([Ask an assistant](../../user/chat/assistant.md)) |
| Outside | a client outside Agent Fleet, such as claude.ai or Claude Code on your own computer | The Control Plane's `/mcp`, with a token or by signing in ([Drive your workspace from an external Claude](../../user/outside/external-claude.md)) |

How to read a cell:

- **Session**: ✓ alone means every session has it. A quoted name is the switch in
  ⚙ Settings → Agents that has to be on; "Agent memory" is the one in ⚙ Settings → Agent memory → Settings.
  "image studio" means only a session working in the image studio.
- **Assistant**: "AF read" means an assistant with either grant has it; "AF write" means only an assistant
  allowed to write.
- **with a browser**: not offered in a workspace that has no browser ([deployment targets](../deploy-targets.md)).
- **Outside**: `read` or `write` is the scope the token or connected app needs. "admin" means only tenant
  administrators and deployment administrators see it. "memory" means only when memory may be used from outside
  ([Use memory from an external agent](../../user/memory/external.md)); those tools are also all that
  `/mcp/memory` serves.
- **Required parameters** are the ones a call cannot leave out. The tool list a client receives describes
  every parameter.

## Finish and stop

| Tool | What it does | Session | Assistant | Outside | Required parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `af_report` | Report once that an instruction carrying an `[agent-fleet]` note is fully done | ✓ | — | — | — |
| `af_stop_after_turn` | Schedule this session to stop at the end of its turn, or cancel that | ✓ | — | — | — |
| `propose_session_handoff` | Propose to you the first prompt of a follow-up session; it starts nothing itself | ✓ | — | — | `title`, `prompt` |

## See sessions

| Tool | What it does | Session | Assistant | Outside | Required parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `list_my_sessions` | List the workspace's sessions with their kind, state and working directory | — | ✓ AF read | ✓ `read` | — |
| `get_session_status` | Show a session's state (working, idle, asking, waiting for plan approval) and its pending question | ✓ | ✓ AF read | ✓ `read` | Session: —; Assistant, Outside: `name` |
| `get_session_output` | Read a session's recent output. In a session or an assistant it continues from the last read; from outside, pass the returned cursor as `since` to continue, or each call returns the latest tail. A session may read only its own children | ✓ "Starting sessions from sessions" | ✓ AF read | ✓ `read` | `name` |
| `get_session_usage` | Show each session's context use and cumulative token use | ✓ | ✓ AF read | ✓ `read` | — |
| `get_agent_usage` | Show each agent CLI's subscription usage and rate limits | ✓ "Starting sessions from sessions" | ✓ AF read | ✓ `read` | — |
| `search_sessions` | Full-text search over what was said in this workspace's past sessions, stopped and archived ones included | ✓ "Past-session search" | — | — | — |

## Start and drive sessions

| Tool | What it does | Session | Assistant | Outside | Required parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `create_session` | Start a new session and hand it its first task | ✓ "Starting sessions from sessions" | ✓ AF write | ✓ `write` | — |
| `list_child_sessions` | List the child sessions this session started, with their state and the slots left | ✓ "Starting sessions from sessions" | — | — | — |
| `rename_child_session` | Rename a child session this session started | ✓ "Starting sessions from sessions" | — | — | `name`, `title` |
| `list_repos` | List the git working copies in the workspace (`~/repos`) | ✓ "Starting sessions from sessions" | ✓ AF read | ✓ `read` | — |
| `list_models` | List the models each agent can use right now | ✓ "Starting sessions from sessions" | ✓ AF write | ✓ `read` | `kind` |
| `send_to_session` | Send a prompt to a session to run, resuming it first when it is stopped | — | ✓ AF write | ✓ `write` | `name`, `prompt` |
| `answer_session_question` | Answer a session's pending question by choosing an option | — | ✓ AF write | — | `name`, `choices` |
| `respond_session_plan` | Approve or reject a plan a session is waiting on (claude only) | — | ✓ AF write | — | `name`, `decision` |
| `stop_session` | Stop a session; its conversation and working copy stay and it can be resumed. A session may stop only its own children | ✓ "Starting sessions from sessions" | ✓ AF write | ✓ `write` | `name` |
| `stop_session_after_turn` | Stop a session once its current turn ends, without interrupting it. A session may do this only to its own children | ✓ "Starting sessions from sessions" | ✓ AF write | ✓ `write` | `name` |
| `resume_session` | Resume a stopped session with its conversation kept. A session may resume only its own children | ✓ "Starting sessions from sessions" | ✓ AF write | ✓ `write` | `name` |
